excerpt.zh:

形成这些深层隧道的岩浆流现在已经休眠，留下了富饶的矿脉，这些矿脉是在很久以前[From.GetName]熔融核心的极端高温和高压下形成的。

这些火成矿藏非常密集；在此地的开采作业成本高昂，但利润丰厚。

texts.en:
Drying the climate on [From.GetName] uncovered a vast network of lava tubes throughout the planet's newly-exposed ocean floor.

The magma flows which created these deep tunnels are dormant now, leaving behind a rich seam of minerals forged long ago in the extreme heat and pressure of [From.GetName]'s molten core.

These pyroduct deposits are extremely dense; extraction operations here will be costly but highly lucrative.
